## [1.5.0](https://github.com/MOD-PROD/Morphe-Patches-by-Modprod/compare/v1.4.1...v1.5.0) (2026-11-04)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* retirer la gestion des noms sur plusieurs lignes ([e637570](https://github.com/MOD-PROD/Morphe-Patches-by-Modprod/commit/e637570529dfa4203fc6786fe76b42efb495c29e))
* supprimer la conversion des retours à la ligne dans le nom ([0bae94b](https://github.com/MOD-PROD/Morphe-Patches-by-Modprod/commit/0bae94b66a421c8bc5a61c7cff9ba24544b9ed38))

### ✨ New Features

* ajouter des images PNG personnalisées pour l'icône et la bannière ([e5473c5](https://github.com/MOD-PROD/Morphe-Patches-by-Modprod/commit/e5473c5f3000c34f35081305934c24f104d8ec11))

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Changes the app name shown on the launcher and in the app list.

options.description: Name shown under the icon / banner. Use a single line.

patches.name: Clone app
patches.description: Changes the package name so the patched app can be installed next to the original TizenTube. Default package name: mod.android.youtube.tv.

options.description: Package name of the cloned app. Each cloned install needs a unique package name.
Rename custom permissions declared by the app. Prevents install conflicts with the original app.
Rename content provider authorities. Prevents install conflicts with the original app.

patches.name: Inject Adblocker Userscript
patches.description: Injects a JavaScript userscript into the YouTube TV web app running in Cobalt. The script removes ad placements from InnerTube responses before the app reads them.

options.description: Absolute path to a .js file on the patching device. If the file does not exist, the bundled script (ad blocker, sponsored tiles, playback speed keeper) is used.

patches.name: MOD Icon and Banner
patches.description: Replaces the app icon and the Android TV launcher banner with YouTube artwork. On Android TV the launcher shows the banner, so both are replaced.

options.description: Replace android:icon (app list, settings, phone launchers).
Replace android:banner (Android TV / Google TV home screen).
Optional absolute path to a PNG image on the patching device. Leave empty for the bundled icon. Recommended: square PNG, at least 320x320.
Optional absolute path to a PNG image on the patching device. Leave empty for the bundled banner. Recommended: 16:9 PNG, at least 640x360.
